q: Does reclaiming foundry sand lower or raise a foundry's carbon footprint?
title: Foundry sand reclamation: carbon effect
short: Usually lower overall, but not on site. Mechanical reclamation adds electricity and thermal reclamation adds gas or oil to your Scope 1 and 2, while it cuts new sand mining, transport and landfill, which sit in Scope 3. Count both sides with your own figures before claiming a saving.
audience: Foundries in Kolhapur, Belgaum, Coimbatore and Rajkot considering mechanical or thermal sand reclamation

ul: Electricity for attrition and classifying units x 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh.
Gas, LPG or oil for thermal reclamation that burns off resin binders.
New silica sand bought, and its quarrying and drying.
Truck trips for new sand and for waste sand to landfill.
Disposal fees, which often pay for the unit.

p: Show the on site increase and the upstream and waste decrease separately, with the tonnes behind each. Buyers distrust a single net figure without the parts.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel, electricity and freight invoices into a dated, fingerprinted record per site, so each figure you send a buyer can be traced back to the documents behind it.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
